purpose: Diagnostic repeatability check prompted by mixed primary test effects. This does not replace the primary development-selected release.
changes: Only model initialization, dropout and training shuffle seeds change; data split seed remains 17, all data and hyperparameters stay fixed.
selection: Each checkpoint uses development NLL. The original seed-17 release stays frozen.
analysis: Report every seed and paired augmented-minus-public differences; bootstrap intervals over examples alone do not capture training-seed uncertainty.
